senses.gloss:
The base of the second personal pronoun; (nom. त्वम्, युवाम्, यूयम्) Thou, you; (at the beginning of several compounds). 
-Comp. 
-अर्थम् ind. for you. 
-आयत्त a. at your disposal. 
-वाच्यम् (in gram.) the second person. 
-विध a. like you.

a. Your, yours. 
-यः A countryman of yours; [[Ratn.]]

यूषः,
 
-षम्, -यूषन् m., n. Soup, broth, pease-soup. (यूषन् has no forms for the first five inflections, and is optionally substituted for यूष after acc. dual.)
